C8 was already met on main by #1282 and still holds after #1420 (commonsthread-desktop-light-clip, commonsgardener-phone-light). Folded into one PR with gd-HEky8ZLUVK: https://github.com/mattbakerconsulting/gardenio/pull/1461

# Commons UX grade: the Commons pane's cuts and composers (gd-EvK4BmuKos + gd-HEky8ZLUVK), 2026-10-29

Surfaces: commonsstress, commonsstormstress, commonscrew, commonsthread, commonsgardener, plus two new open-state rows in shoot.js: commonstopicopen (the #stress topic tapped open) and commonsstormopen (the storm's "and 32 more" opened). Cells: phone-light, phone-dark, desktop-light, desktop-dark, mid, focus. Fixture farm, no page errors, perf not measured (CSS + template only, 0 B JS).

| Gate | Before | After | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 Truncation | FAIL: topic clamped to 2 lines with only a hover title on touch (ellipsisNoWay `p.cm-topic`, line-clamp 2, commonsstress-phone-light/mid); storm's "and 32 more" is plain text over 7 named agents | PASS: the topic is a `<details>` whose summary is the clamped topic, so a tap opens it whole (commonstopicopen-phone-light/mid) and a click does on desktop (commonstopicopen-desktop-light); the topic's ellipsisNoWay hit is gone. "and 32 more" opens on s8-s14 and "and 25 not named" (commonsstormopen-*); a count with no names behind it says "and 2 not named" (commonscrew-mid) | |
| C2 Wrapping | PASS | PASS | open topic wraps inside the header, no sideways hits |
| C3 Phone | PASS | PASS: topic tap target is 44 px+ on touch (an ::after slop over the channel name, no smallTarget hit); the storm summary is 44 px tall on touch | commonscrew-phone-light probes |
| C4 Desktop | PASS | PASS | commonsstormopen-desktop-dark, commonstopicopen-desktop-light |
| C5 Light/dark | PASS | PASS | commonsstormopen-phone-dark |
| C6 Card themes | N/A | N/A | no card theme in /garden |
| C7 Glyphs | PASS | PASS | Arabic in the typing line renders |
| C8 Controls | PASS | PASS: composers read "Message #stress" / "Reply in thread" / "Reply to g-down-b (not running: not nudged)" (from #1282, still in place after #1420) | commonsthread-desktop-light-clip, commonsgardener-phone-light |
| C9 State | PASS | PASS | |
| C10 Live | N/A | N/A | static grade, no SSE driver |
| C11 Density | FAIL: 'and N more' a dead end under a list of 8 | PASS: 8 named, the rest one tap away | commonsstormopen-mid |
| C12 Links/a11y | PASS | PASS: both summaries named by their text; focus ring 3px gold on summaries | focus draft lines |

Score: before 8/10 (80 %, revise) -> after 10/10 (100 %, accept). N/A: C6 (no card theme), C10 (static grade).
Unchanged from main, not this PR's: on #stress, clamped decision/escalation/agent-card fields (ellipsisNoWay x7-8, each card links to its bead), "Bead not found" links at 22-43 px (smallTarget x3), 12 px card meta (tinyText x10). Same counts before and after.
Goldens: commons-phone-*, commonsjoin-phone-*, commonsmention-phone-* (anti-aliasing of the channel name under the topic's tap slop), commonscrew-*, commonsdeath-desktop-* ("and 2 not named"). commonsdecisions untouched.

PR: https://github.com/mattbakerconsulting/gardenio/pull/1461
